usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the SMART health and attribute data for a specific block device on a PVE node. The node must be online and reachable, and the caller must hold `Sys.Audit` on `/`. Set `healthonly: true` for a lightweight pass/fail check; omit it to retrieve the full attribute table and raw smartctl text, which is useful for diagnosing early-warning reallocated sectors or pending uncorrectable errors.

examples.summary: Get full SMART data for an NVMe drive on node pve1

tips: The disk path must match the pattern ^/dev/[a-zA-Z0-9\/]+$ — use get_nodes_node_disks_list first to enumerate valid device paths for the node.
When healthonly is true the response only contains the `health` field (e.g. 'PASSED' or 'FAILED'), which is faster and suitable for automated health checks.
SMART data is read directly from the device at request time; for NVMe drives the `type` field in the response will reflect the NVMe protocol rather than ATA.
This endpoint is read-only and has no side effects on the disk or running VMs.
